description: Triggers when a Google Calendar event tagged as Fika Sync focus time is moved or cancelled (RailCall webhook capability NOT confirmed
Triggers a weekly check of accumulated debt even if there were no calendar changes that week
Fetches the event again to confirm whether the focus-time block still exists or was moved/cancelled
Records the focus-time debt if the block was moved or cancelled (pure logic)
Calculates each affected person's outstanding debt balance
Classifies the debt as 🟢/🟡/🔴 based on thresholds
Publishes the debt status to Slack
Looks for a free slot to give back the lost focus time (only for 🟡/🔴 debt)
Proposes a new focus-time block as debt repayment
Marks the debt as repaid once the new block is confirmed (pure logic)
Generates the signed audit receipt for all actions taken
